caption: The drawing depicted on the plate shows a rural landscape in monochrome, likely shades of grey, indicating a black and white or sepia-toned image. The central scene within the plate’s oval interior features a river or body of water with three people seated in a flat-bottomed boat. On the far bank, there is a collection of buildings, including houses with pitched roofs, and some larger structures, suggesting a small village. Behind the buildings, there are clusters of trees and a sloping hill densely covered with additional trees. The border of the plate is richly decorated with large, detailed floral and leaf patterns that surround the central scene on all sides, with the flowers overlapping and interweaving into a continuous ornate border. The composition is balanced, with the landscape scene at the center framed by the floral design that fills the rim of the plate. The overall color impression is uniform due to the grayscale rendering of the image.
